sections.h2: Medical equipment software for Mumbai, run without a site visit
paras: Aura Business is an operations platform for businesses that import, distribute, install and service medical equipment, and Mumbai companies deploy it remotely from Elevate Aura's studio in Chennai. Scoping happens on a call, data is migrated from your spreadsheets, training is over screen-share, and support is on WhatsApp with the founder who built it.

Elevate Aura has no presence in Mumbai and does not offer on-site work there. For a national distributor whose own dealers are spread across the country, a platform built to be run remotely is the point rather than a compromise.

sections.h2: The goods land in Mumbai. The customers are everywhere else.
sections.lead: Mumbai is where a large share of imported medical equipment enters the country and where many national distributors are headquartered. The operational consequence is that most of what a Mumbai distributor sells leaves Maharashtra, through a dealer network that has to be priced, supplied, paid and supported state by state.
body: The dealer network is the first thing to put in order. Each dealer holds an authorisation for certain brands and territories, buys at its own price list, pays by bank transfer, and wants to know when the consignment will ship. Aura Business records brand and authorisation per dealer, loads dealer price lists, gives each dealer a branded portal to order and upload UTRs, and shows order status on a tracking page so the phone stops ringing.

Interstate billing is the second. A Mumbai distributor invoicing a dealer in Gujarat, Kerala or Assam applies IGST, and the consignment needs an e-way bill before it moves. The GST Billing suite decides the tax split from the dealer's place of supply, generates the e-invoice IRN and QR, raises the e-way bill from the invoice, and handles credit notes for returns and rate differences. GSTR-1 and 3B prep and a Tally export keep the accountant in step with a high invoice volume.

body.h3: The equipment does not stop at the dealer

body: An importer's obligations follow the equipment: principal warranty to honour, claims to raise with the overseas manufacturer, and an installed base that is the pipeline for AMC and extended warranty. The installed-base register records every serial with the dealer, hospital and warranty start; warranty tracking marks parts replaced under claim; and the renewal engine lists expiring cover by dealer and city so the contract is sold in time.

items.q: Do you visit Mumbai for implementation?
items.a: No. Elevate Aura is based in Chennai and serves Mumbai remotely, with cloud deployment, screen-share onboarding and WhatsApp support. In-person work is limited to Chennai and places in Tamil Nadu reachable by travel.

items.q: Can dealers in different states have different price lists and product access?
items.a: Yes. Each dealer account carries its authorised brands, territory and price list, and the portal shows only what applies. See dealer management software.

items.q: How are IGST and e-way bills handled for interstate supply?
items.a: The tax split is decided by the dealer's GSTIN and delivery address, so interstate supply carries IGST. The e-way bill is generated from the invoice or delivery challan with transporter and vehicle details before dispatch. See GST billing software.

items.q: Does it track warranty claims back to an overseas principal?
items.a: Parts replaced under warranty are recorded with failed and replacement serials, the job card and the GRN they came from, which is the evidence for your claim. The claim itself is raised with the principal in their process; the credit received is tracked in payables.

items.q: Can the installed base be viewed by dealer or state?
items.a: Yes. Every serial in the register carries its dealer, hospital and location, and the reports engine groups installations, warranty status and contracts by any of them. See installed base management software.

items.q: How many users can we have?
items.a: Unlimited users on every Aura Business plan. Plans are by module count, 15, 47 or all 87, so branches, dealers and office staff can all have logins with role-based access.
